oneLine: Virtual pharma API firm HRV preparing for IPO with DRHP likely in H1 2027.

sources.title: Virtual pharma API firm HRV preparing for IPO, DRHP likely in H1 of 2027: Sources

synopsis: Virtual pharma API firm HRV Pharma is preparing for an initial public offering by next year, with a draft red herring prospectus expected to be filed in the first half of calendar 2027. The Hyderabad-based company plans to raise more than Rs 800 crore through the IPO. HRV Pharma has hired ICICI Securities and Equirus Capital as bankers for the transaction. The company did not comment on the IPO plan. Founder and chief executive Hari Kiran Chereddi leads the firm, which provides bulk drugs and formulations using an asset-light model without owning manufacturing plants, outsourcing production across manufacturing sites while retaining control over products and regulatory filings.
